subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result contract and server_error-before-failover retry ordering be accepted after stronger full-runner proof is added?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but it changes a plugin-SDK-exported harness result type and provider failure ordering, which are compatibility and runtime semantics choices maintainers should explicitly own.

options.title: Accept after full-runner proof
options.body: Require redacted runner or gateway evidence, then accept the optional field plus conservative legacy fallback as the canonical fix shape.

options.title: Require a different side-effect signal
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for an internal-only current-attempt signal if maintainers do not want to expand the harness result contract.

options.title: Keep server_error on failover first
options.body: Ask for a narrower patch that fixes cumulative side-effect gating without changing classified server_error retry ordering.

recommendation.title: Accept after full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted runner or gateway evidence, then accept the optional field plus conservative legacy fallback as the canonical fix shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work and current blame/history make steipete the best routing candidate for the retry, replay, and harness contract decision.
